pairs.evidence: crates/runner/src/compare.rs:273 The typed EngineError from generation (which can be OverBudgetWait carrying the provider's stated wait) is turned into a string, and only a boolean reaches TargetHealth::record. An exhausted claude -p or Codex seat therefore cannot be told apart from provider ill health and gets reported as health_filtered.

techniques.evidence: crates/runner/src/compare.rs:273 Cause is stringified and then collapsed to `generation_failed = true` (line 274) feeding `record(&self, ti, generation_failed: bool)` (line 183). There is no plan-reached flag on targets and no exhausted/ambiguous class.

crates/runner/src/budget.rs:44 The pre-flight prints a lower bound when models are unpriced. The live ceiling is an atomic micro-dollar counter checked at case boundaries, and halt_status marks the run partial.
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:1040 Both halves are stamped and the headline is the weaker of them. Multi-draw runs are stamped Sampled, and the stamp folds weakest-first.
crates/runner/src/targets.rs:73 Effort is a typed field on BenchTarget, and display_label carries it (e.g. openai/gpt-4o@low).
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:648 Judge/target family overlap is checked mechanically per target and recorded as a named warning. p50/p95 latency and cost are measured on the same calls.
crates/runner/src/bench.rs:167 dataset_frozen and dataset_version are pinned into the run at run time, and an unfrozen set warns rather than refusing.
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:599 Per-tier means and the discrimination annotation are persisted on the run report through annotate_tiers. No per-tier recommendation is made.
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:1158 Frontier plus recommendation. The test a_halted_run_renders_its_table_and_refuses_to_recommend shows a partial run refuses to recommend.
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:241 Cancel is observed at a case boundary, never mid-call. halt_status reports 'cancelled'. The queue itself lives in serve_job/the stores, outside this context's files.

crates/runner/src/targets.rs:98 Targets can declare a structured-output schema, but compare.rs never reads GenOutcome.schema (grep 'schema' in compare.rs: 0 hits). A shed contract (prose fallback) never reaches the result row.
crates/runner/src/compare.rs:1035 A local runtime behind LIGHTTRACK_OPENAI_BASE is identified (Ollama/vLLM), but no loaded context window or resident fraction is declared or read back into the row.

pairs.subject: cross-provider-benchmark-operations
pairs.evidence: crates/engine/src/providers.rs:304 When a provider rejects the pinned request, generate_deterministic drops the caller's schema and retries. Because the retry has schema None, schema_state stamps it NotRequested rather than Shed (only generate_chat stamps Shed at line 256), so a target's structured-output case hand-lowered into prose is indistinguishable from one that never asked for a schema.

techniques.evidence: crates/engine/src/providers.rs:304 The deterministic path (used for pinned candidate generation and the judge) sheds the schema with only an eprintln. The typed SchemaEnforcement::Shed is never set on this branch.

crates/engine/src/providers.rs:335 The suffix is split once at the boundary every adapter crosses. Adapters get a typed Effort, Gemini refuses by name (gemini.rs:59), and the per-request timeout scales with level (providers.rs:57).
crates/engine/src/providers.rs:459 The CLI path is stamped best-effort. OpenAI/Gemini are stamped Exact only with temperature 0 plus a seed, and the unpinned fallback degrades to BestEffort.

crates/engine/src/retry.rs:111 The engine applies the stated-wait discriminator and returns a typed terminal error carrying asked/remaining seconds. Preserving it downstream is the runner's failure, not this context's.

crates/engine/src/endpoint_probe.rs:5 Local runtimes are a supported target, but the probe records identity only. A search for resident/offload/num_ctx/size_vram across engine, runner and core found nothing.

pairs.evidence: crates/api/src/collective/scorecard.rs:25 run_stat admits any run with a mean, pass rate and cases, and never consults run.status. Budget-halted 'partial' and 'cancelled' compare runs (compare.rs:1075 writes that status) therefore join federated buckets as if complete, so partial is not contagious into the leaderboard.

techniques.evidence: crates/api/src/collective/scorecard.rs:25 There is no status filter in run_stat or gather_run_stats (digest.rs:96), and the leaderboard has no partial banner.
crates/api/src/collective/fold.rs:155 Cross-instance merge folds pessimistically. The hub clamps to the closed vocabulary (sanitize.rs:121).
